description: Überschwemmungsgebiete im Kreis Mettmann is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The floodplains (divided according to status "determined", "fixed", secured" and "preussian") in the district Mettmann on an overview scale. The data was provided by the Düsseldorf district government. State of play 2013. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains in Mettmann County" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Ratingen, Langenfeld, ermittelt, Erkrath, Haan, GISKME. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
